exposure: duration of the second stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
Women with second stage of labor longer than 2 hours
Women with vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
outcome: Incidence of obstetric anal sphincter injuries (third- or fourth-degree perineal lacerations)
cohort: 22,741 women in Kaiser Permanente Northern California with singleton, term, cephalic vaginal deliveries between January 2013 and December 2014
finding: Vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery and prolonged duration of the second stage of labor were associated with higher odds of obstetric anal sphincter injuries.
mod_finding: Vacuum-assisted vaginal delivery conferred the highest odds of obstetric anal sphincter injury followed by prolonged duration of the second stage of labor.
